summary: Return client rect coordinates relative to the viewport, so document scrolling can change x/y/top/left.

target.notes: Layout-derived values delegate to the renderer/layout runtime; this rule owns the DOM/CSSOM View API contract, not CSS layout computation.

semantics.scroll: document scroll offset affects reported client coordinates
semantics.document_coords: caller must combine with scroll offsets if document-relative position is desired

tests.name: scroll sensitivity
tests.expected_behavior: y can change with viewport scroll
